name: vucar
description: Read-only Vietnam used-car valuation, VND price estimates, vehicle catalog search, and side-by-side car comparisons.

interface.longDescription: Use Vucar's public vehicle intelligence tools for Vietnam used-car valuation: search supported makes, models, years, and variants; estimate indicative market and resale values in VND; and compare multiple vehicle price estimates. The integration is read-only, requires no Vucar account, and cannot search live listings or create leads, bookings, auctions, or transactions.
defaultPrompt: Estimate the value of a 2020 Toyota Vios with 50,000 km

Compare indicative values for these used cars
